## About
LaFitte HVAC is family owned and operated, right here on Lakeshore Dr in Conroe. We look after heating and air conditioning for homeowners and businesses throughout Montgomery County and surrounding areas, and we've always treated every customer like part of our family.
Whether you need a repair, replacement, maintenance or a new installation, just call us and we'll be there. Our fair pricing and customer service are what keep our neighbors coming back to us year after year.

## Services
- Heating and Air Conditioning Repair: We get your system running properly as soon as possible, and make sure it keeps running efficiently and reliably.
- Air Conditioning and Heating Installation: New design and installation, equipment upgrades, upkeep and repair of residential and commercial HVAC systems, built for comfort all year round and long-term value.
- Preventative Maintenance: Join our Preventative Maintenance Agreement program to save money and keep your HVAC systems running efficiently.
- Commercial HVAC: Dependable service that keeps employees, customers or tenants comfortable, plus energy efficient systems to help bring your energy costs down.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on commercial properties too?
A: Yes. We serve both residential and commercial properties, from homes to businesses with employees, customers or tenants to keep comfortable.

Q: What area do you serve?
A: We work with homeowners and businesses throughout Montgomery County and surrounding areas, out of our shop on Lakeshore Dr in Conroe.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: We do. Ask us about our financing options and how they can help. A reviewer mentioned being offered financing through Synchrony to pay for a repair.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Fill out the quote form about your needs and our team will get in touch with you. You can also call or email our team.
